question.prompt: Given \(\triangle ABC\cong\triangle DEF\), \(AB=3\), \(BC=4\), and the perimeter of \(\triangle DEF\) is \(12\), find the length of \(AC\).

solutions.explanation: Congruent triangles have equal perimeters, so the perimeter of \(\triangle ABC\) is \(12\), and \(AC=12-3-4=5\).
solutions.title: Use equal perimeters
